summary: The saved desktop and mobile pages show the reviewed English, three visible concept separators and Figure 55 before Figure 56. Both figures are nonblank, framed completely and readable at the inspected media sizes. The desktop whole-page capture has a pressure-unit wrapping defect: N/m ends one line and its superscript 2 appears at the start of the next line before the atmosphere value. Fix this layout separation without changing the retained source formula. Eight authorized screenshots were opened exactly once; no crops, reopens or new rendering occurred.

applicability.orderObservation: The screenshots correctly follow reviewed prose order. Manifest inventory order is not the teaching sequence and is not a missing-asset or source-fidelity defect.

findings.affectedText: The carbon-dioxide critical-pressure example: approximately 7.4 x 10^6 N/m^2 (73 atmospheres).
findings.observation: In the desktop whole-page capture, the first pressure-example sentence ends a visual line at N/m. The standalone superscript 2 is at the left of the next line immediately before (73 atmospheres), rather than staying attached to the unit. This is a visible line-association defect, not a claim that the retained mathematical content is wrong.
findings.readerImpact: A child must reconstruct the squared unit across a line break and can read the first line as N/m or attach the isolated 2 to the following atmosphere value.
findings.focusedRecommendation: At the rendering/layout layer, keep the existing N/m text and its adjacent retained exponent together as a nonbreaking unit, allowing a wrap before the entire unit if needed. Preserve prose, numbers, formulas, source subscripts, source ARIA, native evidence and SVG bytes. Do not solve this by changing the original expression or translating its subscripts.
findings.evidenceLimit: The whole-page image was preview-resized from 1440x6587 to 1312x6000. The separated lines are visible, but this does not certify every fine mathematical glyph or provide a full-resolution formula-detail review. No crop or reopen was made.
findings.mobileComparison: The corresponding unit appears together in the tall mobile overview; no matching detached-unit layout was observed there. That preview is not fine-glyph certification.
findings.scope: One observed desktop text-layout defect. No new source, scientific, numerical or figure-geometry approval is issued.

visibleObservations.opening: The title, chapter breadcrumb and revised isotherm explanation are clearly separated and readable. The text column has comfortable margins, line spacing and paragraph gaps. The saved definitionScreenshot shows the opening viewport, not a close-up of the later critical formulas; its legacy polarization basename does not describe its visible content.
visibleObservations.wholePage: The full vertical overview contains the opening, Figure 55, critical definitions and endpoint discussion, critical-temperature compression, vessel narrative, Figure 56 and caption, historical ether and cover 2 prose, and the final cooling and gas comparison. Three horizontal concept separators are visible. No text/figure overlap or blank figure was observed. EN39-P1 is the local pressure-unit wrapping exception.
visibleObservations.figure55: The figure-only screenshot shows the complete axes, origin, isotherm family, critical K, guides and volume/temperature labels. The marks are high-contrast and separated; outer labels and arrows fit the captured frame. This judges presentation of the unchanged figure, not the correctness of its source inventory or geometry.
visibleObservations.figure56: All five vessels and a-e labels fit in one row, with visible differences in liquid levels, texture and droplets. No vessel or label is clipped or overlapping. The existing schematic meaning is reused, not newly approved.

visibleObservations.opening: The full-size saved viewport confirms readable opening text. The heading and breadcrumb wrap inside the page; the revised explanation wraps naturally without horizontal clipping or collisions. The partial next paragraph at the viewport bottom is normal continuation, not an omitted paragraph.
visibleObservations.wholePage: The tall overview shows the same ordered material and three concept separators, with Figure 55 before Figure 56. Paragraph groups remain visually distinct and both figures stay inside the narrow column. It is an overview, not certification of every fine glyph.
visibleObservations.figure55: At the separately saved 358-pixel media width, the axes, curves, K and outer labels remain visible. Temperature and volume labels are compact but distinguishable; no clipping or mark/label collision was observed.
visibleObservations.figure56: At the separately saved 358-pixel media width, all five vessels and a-e labels remain separated and readable, with visible state/texture differences. No clipped vessel or label was observed.

sourceMathAndAccessibility.observation: The native source expressions and machine source ARIA remain intentionally untranslated. A presentation review of these screenshots neither removes that exception nor proves English pronunciation or full accessibility. EN39-P1 concerns unit wrapping, not the presence of Chinese critical subscripts.
